skill.displayName: 收入与成本截止性核对（免费版）

version.changelog: 正文新增「免费网页版」入口；名称取自 SKILL.md

llm.summary: The skill mostly does the promised local cutoff-workpaper checks, but it also makes a default outbound telemetry call with a stable machine/user-derived identifier despite prominent no-network claims.

dimensions.detail: For a finance/audit workflow, default outbound contact to https://www.tokendidi.cn/api/free-hint with a stable host/user-derived sid is not proportionate to the core local checking function unless it is made prominent and opt-in.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No install hook, dependency installer, startup persistence, or package mutation mechanism was found in the inspected artifact files.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The top-level description says no network is needed, while later documentation and scripts disclose a post-run server call. The JSON result also reports network_used false for the checking scope even though the wrapper may still contact the telemetry endpoint after success.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill does not write files or install persistent local components, but the telemetry sid is deterministically derived from hostname and username, enabling cross-run remote correlation unless --no-stats is used.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The main implementation parses cutoff-test tables and performs the advertised totals, duplicate, blank, date/period, zero-amount, and document-type checks. However, the engine contains stale share-based-payment comments and one insufficient-input prompt that ask for the wrong kind of table.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Review before installing in restricted finance or audit environments. The checked workpaper text is not sent by the inspected code, but successful runs contact an external service by default with a stable pseudonymous identifier; use --no-stats or block network access if that is not acceptable. Also verify results carefully because some internal comments and one error prompt refer to a different accounting workflow.
llm.findings:
[TP4] unexpected: Accepted only in part: the core behavior matches cutoff-workpaper checking, but stale share-based-payment self-description and prompt text are not purpose-aligned and create trust/quality risk rather than proving tool poisoning.
[SDI-1] unexpected: Accepted for the network-disclosure conflict: SKILL.md and engine comments make no-network/local-only claims, while run.mjs performs a default telemetry fetch after successful runs.
[SDI-4] unexpected: Accepted: the prominent local-only wording is inconsistent with the later telemetry section and runtime behavior.
[AE1] expected: Downgraded: scripts/run.mjs was present in the workspace and was fully inspected; referencing it from SKILL.md is normal for a runnable skill.
[LP1] unexpected: Accepted: the outbound fetch is not required for local cutoff checking and expands the environment interaction surface.
[SDI-2] unexpected: Accepted: the telemetry sends a package id plus stable sid derived from hostname and username; it excludes source materials but is still unnecessary tracking metadata for the stated purpose.
[SQP-2] unexpected: Accepted: telemetry is automatic on successful runs unless --no-stats is supplied, with no interactive confirmation.
[SQP-3] expected: Downgraded as a security issue: the Chinese-only text is consistent with the Chinese skill name and sample workflow, though clearer locale scoping would help users.
